chunks: Allāh may bless our master Muḥammad, the Prophet, and his descendants who are lamps of darkness and trustworthy support, and may bestow peace (upon them) abundantly and profusely.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-'Urwah al-Wuthqa' in the context of the Prophet's family?
ai.summary: This closing supplication from the Letter to Ashtar in Nahj al-Balagha employs the Quranic metaphor of 'firm handle' (Wura al-Mutqin) to elevate the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate source of guidance and stability for the community. Sharif al-Radi’s compilation highlights this as a key theological assertion of the Prophet's family's role as spiritual lamps, reinforcing their authority during the era of the Rightly Guided Caliphs.
